ROUND ONE

The Chairman

HP:  35

In Play:  The Operative - 45

Trash: Enforcers x2, Thief x2, Hired Gun x2, Informant x2, Crooked Cop x2

Additional Effects: ST: If there are any Underbosses in the trash, flip The Chairman.

ET:Reveal an Underboss from the villain deck and put it into play.

The Chairman is immune to damage.

Whenever a villain target is destroyed, The Operative deals the hero with the highest HP 3 melee damage.

Reduce damage dealt to The Chairman and The Operative by 1.

------------------------------

Start of Turn:  No Underbosses in the villain trash.

Play a Card:  The Broker enters play.

End of Turn:  The Fence enters play.

An Informant enters play.

A Thief enters play.

Destroy a hero Ongoing or Equipment card - none in play.

------------------------------

HP:  35

In Play:  The Operative - 45

The Broker - 5

The Fence - 6

Informant - 2

Thief - 2

Trash: Enforcers x2, Thief, Hired Gun x2, Informant, Crooked Cop x2

Additional Effects: ST: If there are any Underbosses in the trash, flip The Chairman.

ST: Play the top card of the villain deck.

ET: Reveal an Underboss from the villain deck and put it into play.

ET: Put  a Thief and an Informant from the villain trash into play.

ET: Destroy a hero Ongoing or Equipment card.

The Chairman is immune to damage.

Whenever a villain target is destroyed, The Operative deals the hero with the highest HP 3 melee damage.

Reduce damage dealt to The Chairman and The Operative by 1.

When a hero card is destroyed, The Chairman and The Operative regain 3HP.

When a hero card is played, play the top card of the villain deck.
